beliefs: f adds 1 to the ASCII code of every character (a→b, A→B, space→!, 0→1, 9→:), with no wrapping [E1, E2, E3]
Lowercase letters shift to the next ASCII char, so 'a'→'B' and 'z'→'{' [E3]
Uppercase letters also shift by +1 in ASCII, so 'A'→'B' and 'Z'→'[' [E2, E3]
Digits shift to the next ASCII char, so '0'→'1' and '9'→':' [E2, E3]
Punctuation and symbols shift by +1 as well, e.g. '!'→'"' and '@'→'A' [E1]
Case is not preserved in the usual sense: 'a'→'B' (lowercase becomes uppercase) because it is a raw ASCII +1 [E1, E3]
notes: The key error was assuming case was preserved; actually every char is shifted by +1 in raw ASCII, so 'a'→'B' and 'z'→'{'. This matches all observations including 'hello'→'Ifmmp'.
